requirementResults.01FullScreenLargePanel: passed: inset-zero page-equivalent large extent, top media, top-edge pull and left-edge back both return to medium
requirementResults.02NoVisibleMobileScrollbars: passed: all scroll owners remain operable with scrollbar-width none and zero WebKit chrome
requirementResults.03PresenceDrivenMedia: passed: no-image spots create no media node, placeholder or reserved height
requirementResults.04CenteredSectionRail: passed: rail midpoint equals panel midpoint
requirementResults.05CompactBottomActionRail: passed: normal visual rail is 44 CSS px with 14 CSS px icons and three 44 CSS px targets
requirementResults.06NoiseRemoval: passed: all six named noise phrases and generic operation instructions are absent from visible material code
requirementResults.07ExistingRulerResearch: passed: compatible Taro ScrollView behavior reused; curve, taper and snap remain bounded project-owned geometry
requirementResults.08NoDragBlankGap: passed: drag presentation continuously reflows content; no stale media or top spacer appears
requirementResults.09AppWideInformationDensity: passed: current compact type and spacing roles applied to all five surfaces
requirementResults.10CausalMotion: passed: search, sheets, panels, selection, feedback and route transitions have normal and reduced-motion behavior
requirementResults.11BottomLayerSheet: passed: fixed 180 CSS px sheet, app-bottom gap zero, selected spot and previous panel extent preserved
requirementResults.12StationarySearch: passed: frame delta is zero, autofocus works, outside tap blurs, body reveals downward and fades
requirementResults.13PureWhiteDay: passed: day canvas and surface both resolve to #FFFFFF
requirementResults.14MyAccountHub: passed: compact existing-duty account hub with no copied Amap duties or invented product capability

projectChecks.openDesignCandidateInspector: passed with provider, repository and audited-digest parity
projectChecks.gitDiffCheck: passed with pre-existing line-ending advisory only

boundaries: The current candidate covers the accumulated I15, I18 and I19 requirements; conflicts resolve to I19.
Reference screenshots informed layout and density only; no Amap brand, map tiles, proprietary icons, data or unrelated capability was copied.
Visible product fields are required information structure; bounded representative values do not establish live production facts.
The prototype does not change production logic, APIs, schemas, account behavior, upload behavior, maps or sensor algorithms.
Browser evidence does not establish physical WeChat device, native map control, real sensor quality, system IME, screen reader or low-performance-device behavior.
